episode_summary: In this episode, Megan Walters shares her journey of building a successful real estate business without buying leads or cold calling. She emphasizes the importance of personal branding, leveraging social media, and creating value for potential clients. Megan also discusses her investment strategies and how she manages her time effectively to maximize productivity.
